name: m2a1_stall_terminal
_comment: M2a.1 scenario b) Stall (roundLimit 6, startRound 5): the terminal cell (8,2) is sealed on every side by impassable cells except the choke node (7,2). The rebel stands 3 spaces from the terminal at (5,2); the Reach stormtrooper at (6,1) is closer to the node (1 vs 2 MP). Stall doctrine: attack only while the target presently obstructs (arrival 2 rounds > 1) -> the plan must MOVE onto the node instead of attacking the rebel. Round 6: rebel arrival 2 > remaining 1 -> timer race lost -> deterministic Posture switch to Eliminate with a public log line.
